title: Trace.trace_id lives on Trace.info; repr and accessors must resolve it through info
answers: repr of Trace shows a trace_id that I cannot access
how do I get the trace id from a Trace object
Trace repr prints Trace(trace_id=...) but the attribute is missing
body:
Symptom: Users calling `trace.trace_id` on a Trace get AttributeError, even though the repr shows `Trace(trace_id=...)`.
Root cause: mlflow/entities/trace.py:Trace.__repr__ printed a `trace_id` that is not a field on Trace; the real identifier is `self.info.trace_id` (TraceInfo).
Fix pattern: keep the identifier on `info`. Expose `Trace.trace_id` as a @property returning `self.info.trace_id`, and build repr from a guarded lookup (`getattr(self.info, "trace_id", None) if self.info else None`) formatted with `!r` so the output is a valid Python literal.
Constraints: The property does not guard against `info is None`; only __repr__ has the fallback. Any new Trace-level accessor should delegate to `info` the same way rather than copying fields onto Trace.
Applies to: mlflow/entities/trace.py Trace class; covered by tests/entities/test_trace.py:test_trace_repr_and_trace_id.
applies: Trace entity in mlflow/entities/trace.py and any code that renders or reads the trace identifier.
says: Cannot access trace identifier directly on the returned trace object in Python.
Printed trace representation displays an ID field that fails when accessed in code.
Allow getting the trace identifier property directly from the main trace entity.
Accessing the ID on a retrieved trace raises an attribute missing error.
Trace summary output shows a trace ID that cannot be extracted programmatically.
search: In mlflow/entities/trace.py, the Trace entity stores its identifier on TraceInfo, requiring Trace.trace_id to delegate to self.info.trace_id. Trace.__repr__ prints trace_id using a guarded getattr(self.info, 'trace_id', None) formatted with !r as a Python literal. While __repr__ handles info being None, the Trace.trace_id property does not guard against a missing info object. Any new Trace-level accessors must delegate to info rather than duplicating fields, as verified in tests/entities/test_trace.py:test_trace_repr_and_trace_id.
